auth.brand.body.text: Chats, groups, channels and calls, end-to-end encrypted by default. Lakko's servers never see your messages.

auth.brand.tagline.comment: Headline on the brand panel beside the sign-in and sign-up forms.

auth.error.wrong_credentials.text: Wrong username or password. Check them and try again.
auth.error.wrong_credentials.comment: Sign-in failed. Deliberately does not say which of the two was wrong, so nobody can find out which usernames exist.

auth.explainer.same_answer.comment: Second paragraph of the password explanation.

auth.explainer.title.comment: Link that expands an explanation of how the password is protected.

auth.explainer.ways_back_no_words.text: If you forget it, your recovery phrase, another device that is still logged in, an authenticator app, or a code sent by email or phone get you back in.

auth.language.button.comment: Accessibility label of the globe button on the sign-in and sign-up screens.

auth.password.new_confirm.label.comment: Label of the second new-password field on the recovery forms.

auth.signup.error.fix_name.comment: Sign-up submitted with a profile name that is not allowed.

auth.signup.error.username_taken.text: That username is taken. Choose another one.

auth.signup.have_account.comment: Line under the sign-up form; {link} is the 'Log in' link.

backup.rollback_refused.body.text: The server returned an altered or outdated backup. Your account is safe; we continued without restoring the older data.
backup.rollback_refused.body.comment: Body of the alert shown when a restore refused a backup the server returned rolled back or altered (ADR-0037). Nothing older was loaded.

backup.rollback_refused.title.text: Backup could not be restored safely
backup.rollback_refused.title.comment: Title of the alert shown when a restore refused a rolled-back or altered backup from the server.

backup.stale_restore.body.text: This backup is older than expected ({reason}). {consequence}
backup.stale_restore.body.comment: Dialog body; {reason} says why it was judged old (e.g. how long ago it was signed); {consequence} is the consequence sentence, passed already translated.

backup.stale_restore.confirm.comment: Destructive button: proceeds past the warning.

backup.stale_restore.consequence.text: Restoring it will roll your account back to older state — older messages, and devices you removed may reappear.
backup.stale_restore.consequence.comment: What restoring an older backup does; "devices you removed may reappear" is the security consequence and must stay explicit.

backup.stale_restore.reason.anchor_unrea.text: this device's record of your last backup is unreadable or was tampered with
backup.stale_restore.reason.anchor_unrea.comment: Phrase inside the parentheses of backup.stale_restore.body: the local record of the last backup could not be read.

backup.stale_restore.reason.below_floor.text: older than the last backup restored on this device
backup.stale_restore.reason.below_floor.comment: Phrase inside the parentheses of backup.stale_restore.body: the backup is older than one this device already restored.

backup.stale_restore.reason.head_strippe.text: its signature was removed and it differs from the last backup this device knew
backup.stale_restore.reason.head_strippe.comment: Phrase inside the parentheses of backup.stale_restore.body: the backup came without its signed header and does not match the last known backup.

backup.stale_restore.reason.too_old.text: it was signed longer ago than a current backup would be
backup.stale_restore.reason.too_old.comment: Phrase inside the parentheses of backup.stale_restore.body: on a new device, the backup's signature is older than the allowed window.

backup.stale_restore.title.comment: Confirmation dialog title when the backup found is older than the newest one this account has made (a possible rollback).

call.guest.default_name.comment: Name prefilled for a visitor without an account who joins a call from a link; it becomes the new account's profile name.

call.guest.working.title.comment: Busy row while a guest account is created to join a call from a link.

call.incoming.accept.comment: Button that answers an incoming call.

call.incoming.decline.comment: Button that declines an incoming call.

call.incoming.decline_from.comment: Accessible name of the button that declines a call; {name} is the caller or conversation.

call.link.dead.text: This call has ended or is not active.

call.link.ended.comment: The call ended while the page was open.

call.link.error.generic.comment: Call-link page: the call failed and no more specific reason is known.

call.link.failed.comment: Joining failed; {reason} is a sentence explaining why.

call.link.invalid.text: This call link is invalid or has expired.

call.link.join.comment: Button for anyone joining from the link.

call.link.live.comment: The joiner is in the call.

call.link.loading.comment: Shown while the call link is read.

call.link.title_join.comment: Title of the call-link page for anyone else.

call.link.waiting_hint.text: You can leave this screen; you will join when you are admitted.

chat.attachment.image_alt.comment: Alternative text of an attached picture that has no file name.

chat.attachment.open.comment: Button on an attached picture: show it inside the message.

chat.attachment.save_title.comment: Title of the system sheet that saves or shares a received file.

chat.attachment.unnamed.comment: Stands in for the file name of an attachment that has none.

chat.author.a_member.comment: Name for someone who reacted to a message when they cannot be named.

chat.author.unknown.comment: Name shown for the author of a message when it cannot be resolved.

chat.author.you.comment: Name for the reader as the author of a message, of a reaction or of a quoted message.

chat.call.busy.comment: Shown when starting or joining a group call while another call is already going on.

chat.call.error.start.text: Could not start the call. Try again.

chat.call.group_ended.comment: The reader tried to join a group call that has already ended.

chat.call.group_in_progress.comment: Banner above the timeline while a group call the reader is not in is going on.

chat.call.group_people.text: {count, plural, one {# person in the call} other {# people in the call}}

chat.call.group_starting.comment: Under the group call banner while nobody has joined the call yet.

chat.call.join.comment: Header button in a group with a call in progress: join it with voice.

chat.call.last_ended.timed_out.comment: Line under the timeline after a call was not answered in time.

chat.call.unavailable.text: Group calls are not available right now.
chat.call.unavailable.comment: Shown when group calls cannot be started on this device at the moment.

chat.call.video.comment: Header button that starts a video call.

chat.call.voice.comment: Header button that starts a voice call.

chat.composer.attach_limit.comment: Tooltip of the attach button; {limit} is the largest file size allowed.

chat.day.yesterday.comment: Date separator in the timeline above yesterday's messages.

device_link.compare_hint.text: Make sure the other device shows the same code.

settings.recovery.contact.sub.text: A one-time code sent to your email or phone.
settings.recovery.contact.sub.comment: Line under Email or phone on the Recovery page, before the row is opened.

settings.recovery.contact.unavailable.text: Email and phone recovery are not available right now.
settings.recovery.contact.unavailable.comment: The server has email and phone recovery switched off.

settings.recovery.lede.text: Your recovery phrase restores everything. These get you back into the account when you have lost your password; your messages then come from the phrase or from another of your devices.
settings.recovery.lede.comment: Line under the Recovery title: what the authenticator and email/phone factors do and do not restore.

settings.recovery.phrase.not_saved_here.text: Not saved on this device. Keep your written copy safe.
settings.recovery.phrase.not_saved_here.comment: Recovery page: this device keeps no copy of the recovery phrase.

settings.recovery.phrase.saved_here.comment: Recovery page: this device keeps a copy of the recovery phrase in its secure storage.

settings.recovery.phrase.sub.text: The 24 words you wrote down at signup restore your identity, contacts and messages on a new device.
settings.recovery.phrase.sub.comment: Recovery page: what the recovery phrase restores.

settings.recovery.section.access.comment: Section heading on the Recovery page above the authenticator and email / phone rows: ways to get back into the account.

settings.recovery.section.identity.comment: Section heading on the Recovery page above the recovery phrase row: what restores who you are.

settings.recovery.sign_in_first.text: Sign in first to manage recovery.
settings.recovery.sign_in_first.comment: Recovery page opened without a ready session.

settings.recovery.title.comment: Title of the Recovery row in Security and of the Recovery page (authenticator, email or phone).

settings.recovery.totp.already_enabled.text: An authenticator is already set up for this account. To replace it, sign in again with your recovery phrase or from another device first.
settings.recovery.totp.already_enabled.comment: The account already has an authenticator; the server refuses a silent swap.

settings.recovery.totp.done.text: Authenticator set up. A code from the app can now get you back into your account.

settings.recovery.totp.error.generic.text: Could not set up the authenticator. Try again.
settings.recovery.totp.error.generic.comment: Fallback for any other enrolment failure.

settings.recovery.totp.error.wrong.text: That code did not work. Wait for the next code in the app and try again.
settings.recovery.totp.error.wrong.comment: The enrolment code was wrong or expired.

settings.recovery.totp.key.comment: Line under the QR code; {key} is the secret key in a code font (rendered as an element), for typing it in by hand.

settings.recovery.totp.lede.text: A six-digit code from an authenticator app lets you sign in again if you lose your password.
settings.recovery.totp.lede.comment: Text under the Authenticator app heading.

settings.recovery.totp.scan.text: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or type the key in by hand, then enter the six-digit code the app shows.
settings.recovery.totp.scan.comment: Instruction above the enrolment QR code.

settings.recovery.totp.title.comment: Card heading for the authenticator-app recovery factor.

settings.recovery.totp.unavailable.text: Authenticator setup is not available right now.
settings.recovery.totp.unavailable.comment: The server has authenticator recovery switched off.

settings.section.account.comment: Settings section: sign out, forget this device, delete account.

settings.section.appearance.comment: Settings section: theme and text size.

settings.section.danger_zone.comment: Settings section heading above Log out, Forget this device and Delete account.

settings.section.media.comment: Settings section: camera, microphone and media options.

settings.section.network.comment: Settings section heading above the anti-censorship row.

settings.security.devices.sub.text: See, add and remove the devices on this account.
settings.security.devices.sub.comment: Subtitle of the Devices row in Settings > Security.

settings.security.lede.text: How you sign in, which devices can read your messages, and how you get back in.
settings.security.lede.comment: Line under the Security title in Settings.

settings.security.recovery.sub.text: An authenticator app, an email address or a phone number that gets you back in.
settings.security.recovery.sub.comment: Subtitle of the Recovery row in Settings > Security.

settings.security.safety_numbers.sub.text: Each contact has a safety number. Compare it in person or on a call; matching numbers mean nobody is in between. Find it in the contact's details.
settings.security.safety_numbers.sub.comment: Explains what a safety number is and how to compare it.

settings.security.safety_numbers.title.comment: Row title in Settings > Security explaining safety numbers.

tokens.action_allowance_used.text: You have used today's allowance for this. Try again tomorrow.
tokens.action_allowance_used.comment: An invite link, group link or channel name refused because the account's daily allowance for it is used up.

tokens.lookup_allowance_used.text: You have looked up a lot of people today. Try again tomorrow.
tokens.lookup_allowance_used.comment: Search for a username or channel refused because the account's daily allowance of lookups is used up.

username.a11y_hint.comment: Spoken by the screen reader for the reason under a username field. {message} is the reason, like 'At least 3 characters'.

username.error.empty.comment: Shown under the username field when it is empty.

username.error.invalid_characters.comment: Shown under the username field: usernames may only use a-z, 0-9 and underscore. Keep '_' as is.

username.error.too_long.text: At most {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
username.error.too_long.comment: Shown under the username field when it is too long; {count} is the maximum.

username.error.too_short.text: At least {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
username.error.too_short.comment: Shown under the username field when it is too short; {count} is the minimum.

username.error.unknown.comment: Shown under the username field for any other refusal.

username.hint.shown_as.comment: Hint under a username field when the name is typed in another form (for example with capitals); {username} is how it will show, with @, like @alice.
